slang_script.dialogue:
ARAV: Riy, school mein science fair announce hua hai. Mujhe lagta hai hum milke koi aisa project bana sakte hain jo sabko hairaan kar de aur jeet dilaye.
RIY: Yeh kamaal idea hai, Arav. Main turant hi shuru karne ke liye taiyar hoon.
ARAV: Toh chalo, abhi se planning shuru karte hain aur sabko dikhate hain ki hum kitne capable hain.

RIY: Chinta mat karo, yeh sirf ek choti si galti hai; hum isse seekhenge aur phir se try karenge, zaroor safal honge.

SHARM: Arav, aapne yeh robot kaise banaya aur iska asli upyog kya hai?
ARAV: Maine microcontroller, sensors aur recycled parts ka upyog karke isse design kiya hai; iska mukhya kaam daily chores ko automate karna hai, jaise ki kapde fold karna aur chhote items ko sort karna.

RIY: (khushi se) Yeh kaise ho sakta hai? Main vishwas hi nahi kar pa rahi, hamari jeet!
ARAV: Dadi ko dhanyavaad, unki prerna ke bina yeh mumkin nahi hota. Ab hum milkar celebrate karte hain.
